title: Olive and the Blue Feather
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 3 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ue, aw, tch

pages.illustration: Grey clouds gathering over the garden hedge.

pages.text: Olive wants things for a wet day.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking around the hedge for small treasures to collect.

pages.text: Olive spots a soft blue thing.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl noticing one bright blue feather caught in the hedge.

pages.text: It is a true blue, not green.
pages.illustration: Close view of the bright blue feather against the green hedge leaves.

pages.text: Olive picks it up as a clue.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl carefully lifting the blue feather with one claw.
Olive the owl turning the blue feather over, studying it closely.
Olive the owl glancing up towards Pip's nest in a nearby tree.

pages.text: Olive flies to look for Pip.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying across the garden with the blue feather.

pages.text: Pip is glad Olive has it.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow smiling as Olive holds out his lost blue feather.

pages.text: Olive and Pip rest on the grass.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow sitting together in the hedge.
